page_title: Connect to Work or Games from Anywhere | Parsec

sources.entry: Parsec - Low-latency remote desktop and game streaming tool.

summary.name: Parsec
summary.one_liner: Parsec is a low-latency remote desktop and game streaming tool for accessing your computer, games, or creative software from another device.
use_cases: Play your gaming PC's games from another device
Invite friends for remote couch co-op
Access work software and monitors from anywhere
Remote pen tablet work for artists
Collaborate in real time on a shared session
Give distributed teams secure remote access
summary.what_it_does: Parsec streams a desktop session at up to 4K and 60 frames per second with low latency. The host can share a session with guests and choose which apps guests can see and interact with. Connections are described as peer-to-peer, so they do not pass through Parsec's infrastructure. Warp adds pressure-sensitive pen and Wacom tablet support, 4:4:4 color mode, and multi-monitor support for creative professionals. Teams and Enterprise tiers add admin panel provisioning, SSO, a high-performance relay server, and for Enterprise, API access and SAML SSO with SCIM support.
notable: Peer-to-peer connections that do not pass through Parsec's servers, per the page
Warp adds Wacom/pressure-sensitive pen support and 4:4:4 color
Parsec is SOC 2 Type 2 certified and supports MFA
caveats: Parsec for consumer use is free, but Warp, Teams and Enterprise have 14-day free trials and paid tiers implied
Enterprise relay and API features apply only to the Enterprise tier
Platform support beyond the web page is not stated on this page
